free_tier.stated: Free plan at $0 per month: 5 environment-hours/month, 30 minute environment runtime, 1 concurrent environment, KiCad and FreeCAD (https://www.tryisle.com/, read 2026-10-30)
free_tier.notes: The Developer plan at $29 per month includes 100 environment-hours/month, no per-session runtime cap and 5 concurrent environments; stopping an environment archives it with its files and pauses billing.

per_object_cap.stated: Individual uploads and downloads are limited to 4 MiB.

interface_detail: a REST API authenticated with a Bearer API key on every request, and the Python SDK isle-sdk over it, with screenshot, mouse, keyboard and file-transfer calls

limits.value: the Free plan allows 1 concurrent environment, each running for at most 30 minutes; access is through the Python SDK or the REST API with an API key

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up is 'Continue with GitHub or email' at tryisle.com, then an API key is created in the dashboard. Whether a card or a phone number is asked is unverified: the public pages do not say.

confidence_note: the home page and the documentation were read on 2026-10-30: the home page publishes a Free plan of 5 environment-hours a month with a 30 minute runtime and 1 concurrent environment, and the documentation gives GitHub or email sign-up and access by API key

evidence.proved: 'Save an artifact checkpoint before important actions, then restore it when needed' and 'Isle keeps that work in one desktop session, with screenshots and results returned to the agent after each step', quoted; the page publishes no plan or price
